devdoc.details: This contract implements a proxy that is upgradeable by an admin. To avoid https://medium.com/nomic-labs-blog/malicious-backdoors-in-ethereum-proxies-62629adf3357[proxy selector clashing], which can potentially be used in an attack, this contract uses the https://blog.openzeppelin.com/the-transparent-proxy-pattern/[transparent proxy pattern]. This pattern implies two things that go hand in hand: 1. If any account other than the admin calls the proxy, the call will be forwarded to the implementation, even if that call matches one of the admin functions exposed by the proxy itself. 2. If the admin calls the proxy, it can access the admin functions, but its calls will never be forwarded to the implementation. If the admin tries to call a function on the implementation it will fail with an error that says "admin cannot fallback to proxy target". These properties mean that the admin account can only be used for admin actions like upgrading the proxy or changing the admin, so it's best if it's a dedicated account that is not used for anything else. This will avoid headaches due to sudden errors when trying to call a function from the proxy implementation. Our recommendation is for the dedicated account to be an instance of the {ProxyAdmin} contract. If set up this way, you should think of the `ProxyAdmin` instance as the real administrative interface of your proxy. NOTE: The real interface of this proxy is that defined in `ITransparentUpgradeableProxy`. This contract does not inherit from that interface, and instead the admin functions are implicitly implemented using a custom dispatch mechanism in `_fallback`. Consequently, the compiler will not produce an ABI for this contract. This is necessary to fully implement transparency without decoding reverts caused by selector clashes between the proxy and the implementation. WARNING: It is not recommended to extend this contract to add additional external functions. If you do so, the compiler will not check that there are no selector conflicts, due to the note above. A selector clash between any new function and the functions declared in {ITransparentUpgradeableProxy} will be resolved in favor of the new one. This could render the admin operations inaccessible, which could prevent upgradeability. Transparency may also be compromised.

constructor.details: Initializes an upgradeable proxy managed by `_admin`, backed by the implementation at `_logic`, and optionally initialized with `_data` as explained in {ERC1967Proxy-constructor}.

devdoc.details: When epoch is running no deposits or withdrawals are allowed. When epoch ends  lenders can request withdrawals, that will be fullfilled by the end of the next epoch. If the apr for the new epoch is lower than the last one, lenders can request 'instant'  withdrawals that will be fullfilled when the epoch starts and after instantWithdrawDelay (3 days). Funds for instant and normal withdrawals are sent to the strategy contract (IdleCreditVault)

params._limit: limit in underlying value, 0 means no limit

depositAA(uint256).details: msg.sender should approve this contract first to spend `_amount` of `token`

depositBB(uint256).details: msg.sender should approve this contract first to spend `_amount` of `token`

emergencyShutdown().details: can be called by both the owner and the guardian

finalizeDefault(uint256,address).details: `_recoverySource` must approve the strategy for `_recoveredAmount`. Recovered funds are sent directly to the strategy recovery reserve so they do not inflate CDO NAV before finalization. Finalization is one-time and cannot be topped up through this recovery path. Any raw underlying held by the CDO is treated as a donation and sent to `feeReceiver` before recovery is calculated. Recovery uses one aggregate multiplier and does not preserve AA seniority. Before applying that multiplier, active gross backing is split by saved NAV and active default interest uses the configured AA/BB APR split, matching the tranche-specific interest in fixed-APR receipts. A zero or subprecision aggregate recovery finalizes at price zero so tranche prices expose the full loss and pending receipts can be cleared without a payout.

params._recoveredAmount: amount of underlying recovered for active LPs and defaulted receipts
params._recoverySource: address that supplies the recovered underlying

returns._0: actual apr given current ratio between AA and BB tranches

getCurrentAARatio().details: _virtualBalance is used to have a more accurate/recent value for the AA ratio because it calculates the balance after splitting the accrued interest since the last depositXX/withdrawXX

returns._0: AA tranches ratio (in underlying value) considering all interest

getFundsFromBorrower(uint256).details: Get funds from borrower through an external self-call so callers can use try/catch.

getInstantWithdrawFunds().details: Instant withdrawals are not supported when a programmable borrower is configured.

params._governanceFund: address where funds will be sent in case of emergency
params._owner: guardian address (can pause, unpause and call emergencyShutdown)

returns._0: true if wallet is allowed or keyring address is not set

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pause().details: can be called by both the owner and the guardian

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

restoreOperations().details: can be called by the owner only

setEpochParams(uint256,uint256).details: IMPORTANT: bufferPeriod should not be changed once set otherwise interest calculations will be wrong

setFeeParams(address,uint256,uint256,uin.details: Reverts if `_feeReceiver` is address(0). Use `_feeSplit = 0` to route all fees to `owner()`.

params._feeReceiver: fee receiver address. It gets the portion of fees specified by `_feeSplit`. The remaining fee portion goes to `owner()`.
params._feeSplit: portion of collected fees sent to `_feeReceiver` (100000 = 100%)

params._aprDelta: min apr delta to trigger instant withdraw

params._active: flag to allow Adaptive Yield Split

params._isDisabled: true to disable deposits during an epoch

setIsInterestMinted(bool).details: Programmable borrowers always require minted-interest accounting.

params._isMinted: true to mint interest instead of transferring underlyings

setIsProgrammableBorrower(bool).details: This is configured explicitly instead of inferring from code size so contract borrowers such as Safe wallets are not misclassified. The flag cannot be changed while an epoch is live.

params._isProgrammable: true to enable programmable-borrower hooks and accounting

params._aprSplit: min apr split for AA, considering FULL_ALLOC = 100%

startEpoch().details: We calculate the total funds that the borrower should return at the end of the epoch ie interests + fees from normal withdraw requests. We send to the borrower underlyings amounts ie interests +  new deposits - instant withdraw requests if any. If funds are not enough to satisfy all requests then borrower should return the difference before instantWithdrawDeadline. After epoch start there should be no underlyings in this contract

stopEpoch(uint256,uint256).details: Only owner or manager can call this function. Borrower MUST approve this contract

params._interest: Interest gained in the epoch. This will overwrite the expected interest must be 0 if there is no need to overwrite the expected interest and if > 0 then it should be greater than the pending withdraw fees and newApr must be 0. If `_interest` is 1 then it is interpreted as a special case where we request everything back from the borrower. Programmable borrowers only support `_interest` values `0` and `1`.
params._newApr: New apr to set for the next epoch

stopEpochWithDuration(uint256,uint256,ui.details: see stopEpoch and setEpochParams for more details, bufferPeriod is not modified Loss accounting policy for `_lossAmount`: - pending receipts share the pending portion of the loss pro rata because tranche identity is not stored - the remaining active-position loss uses the ordinary BB-first tranche waterfall - hard borrower defaults instead apply one aggregate recovery multiplier to active and pending claims - if `stopEpoch` defaults (`defaulted = true`), the post-stop loss burn and epoch updates are skipped,   but variant hooks still run so prefunded queues can settle deposits already sent to the borrower

params._lossAmount: Amount of strategy tokens to burn as realized loss
params._newApr: New apr to set for the next epoch

returns._0: tranche price, in underlyings, at the last interaction (not considering interest earned  since last interaction)

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

params._token: address of the token to transfer

unpause().details: can be called by both the owner and the guardian

updateAccounting().details: Prevents unsolicited transfers from being crystallized as tranche gains by manual accounting.

params._amount: Amount of tranche tokens to write off

keyringAllowWithdraw.details: Deprecated storage slot. Do not remove: kept to preserve the upgradeable storage layout.

allowBBWithdrawRequest().notice: flag to allow BB withdraw requests

emergencyShutdown().notice: pause deposits and redeems for all classes of tranches

epochEndDate().notice: end date of the current epoch

expectedEpochInterest().notice: expected interest for the current epoch

finalizeDefault(uint256,address).notice: Finalize a hard-default recovery and crystallize the realized loss on tranche prices.

getCurrentAARatio().notice: calculates the current AA tranches ratio

getInstantWithdrawFunds().notice: Get funds from borrower to fullfill instant withdraw requests Manager should call this method after instantWithdrawDeadline (when epoch is running)

instantWithdrawAprDelta().notice: min apr change to trigger instant withdraw

instantWithdrawDeadline().notice: deadline to allow instant withdraw requests

instantWithdrawDelay().notice: delay to allow instant withdraw requests after next epoch starts

isDepositDuringEpochDisabled().notice: flag to disable deposits during an epoch

isEpochRunning().notice: flag to check if epoch is running

isInterestMinted().notice: flag to mint interest as strategy tokens without moving underlyings

isWalletAllowed(address).notice: Check if wallet is allowed to interact with the contract

lastEpochApr().notice: apr of the last epoch, unscaled

maxWithdrawable(address,address).notice: Get the max amount of underlyings that can be withdrawn by user

pendingWithdrawFees().notice: fees from pending withdraw request for the curr epoch

requestWithdraw(uint256,address).notice: Request a withdraw from the vault

restoreOperations().notice: allow deposits and redeems for all classes of tranches

sendFundsToBorrower(uint256).notice: workaround to have safeTransfer to borrower as external and use it in a try/catch block

setBBDepositEnabled(bool).notice: Enable or disable deposits into the BB tranche.

setIsDepositDuringEpochDisabled(bool).notice: set flag to disable deposits during an epoch

setIsInterestMinted(bool).notice: set flag to mint interest as strategy tokens without moving underlyings

setIsProgrammableBorrower(bool).notice: Set whether the current strategy borrower should be treated as programmable.

startEpoch().notice: Start the epoch. No deposits or withdrawals are allowed after this.

stopEpoch(uint256,uint256).notice: Stop epoch, accrue interest to the vault and get funds to fullfill normal (ie non-instant) withdraw requests from the prev epoch.

stopEpochWithDuration(uint256,uint256,ui.notice: Stop epoch and set new duration

transferToken(address,uint256).notice: Emergency method, tokens gets transferred to the governanceRecoveryFund address

updateAccounting().notice: Skim raw donated underlyings before forcing accounting.

virtualPrice(address).notice: calculates the current tranches price considering the interest/loss that is yet to be splitted ie the interest/loss generated since the last update of priceAA and priceBB (done on depositXX/withdrawXX)

writeOffDeposit(uint256,address).notice: Write off the deposit, this will be used if the borrower and a lender comes to an off-chain agreement so here we burn tranche tokens, the equivalent amount of strategy tokens. Only the borrower can call this
